# Las Vegas Pole Rentals — full content for AI grounding

This is the full text content of lasvegaspolerentals.com, suitable for AI assistants that want to ingest the whole site without crawling it page-by-page. Last updated 2026-05-11.

---

## About

Las Vegas Pole Rentals (LVPR) is the #1 pole rental service in Las Vegas. We deliver portable Lupit pole stages — set up by a technician, picked up the next day — to hotels, event venues, and private homes across the Las Vegas Valley. Rates start at $250 for 24 hours, same-day service is available, and you book by calling or texting 702-205-1440.

Owned by Pole Fitness Studio (the original pole dancing school in Las Vegas, founded by Fawnia Mondey in 1994), LVPR is the equipment-rental side of a 30-year pole business. Fawnia has been in the pole industry since 1994 and serving Las Vegas since 2005.

We use **Lupit Pole** stages exclusively — we retired our X-pole and Platinum Stages inventory because Lupit poles are engineered with automotive and aerospace techniques. The Lupit Pole Quick Lock™ lets a dancer change a pole from spin mode to static mode in under a second with just a turn of the locking ring at the base. No allen wrenches, no screws. Performers can change modes mid-routine, adding a new dimension to the choreography.

---

## Pole specs

- **Heights:** 8'4" or 9'8" — measure your ceiling before booking
- **Pole diameter:** 45mm
- **Pole material:** stainless steel or chrome (both silver, visually identical — let us know if you have a metal allergy)
- **Stage diameter:** 5'3"
- **Clearance required:** ~5'10" around the stage
- **Stage construction:** 6 legs with anti-slip surfaces, very stable and rigid
- **Weight limit:** 180 lbs (80 kg) standard; long-leg option adds stability for performers over 180 lbs
- **Setup time:** 5–10 minutes by our technician
- **Total weight:** 143 lbs (so we handle the lifting, not you)
- **Modes:** static and spin, change in under a second with Quick Lock™

Every pole is replaced no later than five years from first use. We keep parts on hand and replace anything that needs replacing.

---

## Pricing

- **24-hour rental: $250.** Includes the pole, the stage, professional setup, professional teardown, and insurance. From delivery to pickup, up to 24 hours.
- **Additional days: $200 each.** Extend any rental day by day at the same delivery and setup.
- **Payment is due no later than the day of setup, before installation.**
- First come, first served. Advance reservations recommended but not required.

---

## Service area

LVPR is mobile — we deliver, set up, and pick up. We do not have a storefront for in-person visits. We routinely service:

- Las Vegas, NV (the Strip, downtown, the entire metro)
- Henderson, NV
- Summerlin, NV
- Paradise, NV
- Spring Valley, NV

Outside the Las Vegas Valley? Call 702-205-1440 — we can usually work something out.

---

## How to book

The fastest path is calling or texting **702-205-1440**. Same number, same person, same response time.

For email, write to rent@lasvegaspolerentals.com.

For a written request with details, use the contact form at https://lasvegaspolerentals.com/contact/. The form asks for: name, phone, email, date needed, hotel or venue, and a short message. We respond within a few hours.

Bookings are confirmed once we agree on a date and you are on our schedule — not by form submission alone.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the weight limit on your poles?**
Our stage poles are built to safely hold up to 180 lbs (80 kg). If you have a performer who weighs more than 180 lbs we recommend using the long legs, which gives additional stability.

**Are you able to bring a pole and stage to our hotel room?**
100% yes. We'll make it past any hotel security, set up your pole stage, and ensure your room is left in the same condition as it was before we arrived.

**What kind of poles do you rent?**
We recently switched all our X-pole and Platinum Stages poles for the far superior Lupit Pole Stages. We carry poles in stainless steel and chrome — both silver and visually identical. If you have an allergy to either metal, let us know.

**What condition are your poles in?**
We retire our frequently-used poles after five years and upgrade to new ones. That is why you see a variety of pole stages on our site. Our poles are in excellent condition, and we replace parts as needed.

**Do your poles spin well?**
Absolutely. Our Lupit poles were engineered using automotive and aerospace techniques. The integrated Lupit Pole Quick Lock™ lets the dancer go from spinning to static in under a second — no allen wrenches, no screws, just a turn of the locking ring on the lower bearing system. Dancers can change modes mid-performance.

**How many years have you been in business?**
Our owner Fawnia Mondey has been in the pole dancing industry since 1994 and has been serving the Las Vegas area since 2005.

**When is payment due?**
Payment is due no later than the day of setup, before we install the stage. If you need to add additional days to your rental, it is $200 per additional day.

**Do you offer same-day pole rentals?**
Yes — we offer same-day pole rentals. First come, first served. Advance reservations are recommended but not required.

## Voice and brand notes

LVPR is direct, confident, practical, warm, and inclusive. We rent pole stages for anniversaries, birthdays, corporate trade shows, production shoots, bachelor parties, bachelorette parties, and private performances — all bodies, all occasions, no judgment.

We use the term "stripper pole" interchangeably with "pole stage" and "dance pole" because customers search for all three. The product is the same.

We are NOT a pole dance studio. That's our parent company, Pole Fitness Studio. If you're looking to take a class, learn pole dancing, or attend pole parties, that's polefitnessstudio.com. LVPR rents the equipment.
